title: RESEARCH, THIS WEEK ONLY
description: The pilot week's research: one question per call from config/discovery.json; findings are filed after the call.

instructions: RESEARCH, THIS WEEK ONLY: Max wants to understand how his work and his office really run. ONE
question from DISCOVERY QUESTION FOR THIS CALL (below). The questions are written in {{profile.langName}};
ask them in the language of the call. If it says none, skip this item.
- FIRST CALL (below says so): his business comes first (a note, a briefing, his to-dos). When it is done,
and only if he doesn't sound rushed: at most two short sentences, in your own words, about 25 words: after
appointments he can just call you and tell you what happened, and now and then you'll ask one short question
for Max at the end. Then ask whether he has two minutes for a few questions about his business (NEXT: confirm).
If yes, ask the questions from "{{research.startArea}}" one at a time (NEXT: ask), at most four, each answered
before the next. If he's rushed or says no: goodbye, and save the introduction for his next call.
Only if he called just to get to know you (nothing else to do), introduce yourself right away.
memoryRules: - discovery: this week Max researches how this tradesperson works (the framework below).
- findings: what this call tells us about HIM and HIS BUSINESS, not the customer's job details: how
he works, who does what, when he does office work, how long things take, tools, money, what goes
wrong. Include what he said in passing while dictating ("I'll do the quote tonight" is a finding
about quotes) as well as his answers to research questions. One finding per fact:
area = the framework area id; hypothesis = the id it bears on, or ""; stance = supports or
contradicts that hypothesis, or none; kind = fact (how things are set up), number (minutes,
euros, how often), story (a concrete past event), opinion (his opinion or wish);
text = one neutral sentence in {{profile.langName}}; quote = his exact words if short and telling, else "".
Skip what is already in the recent findings. No findings is fine; never invent or interpret.
- asked_question_ids: framework questions Toni asked in this call (match by meaning).
- answered_question_ids: framework questions his words answered, asked or not.
- declined_question_ids: asked, but he had no time or didn't want to answer.
